answer: Each agent’s influence can be capped unless it posts a bond that is slashed when independent reviewers confirm fraud. The bond is locked for a fixed challenge window, and reviewers sample claims against external evidence rather than trusting an echo of other agents’ votes. A sybil operator must fund every identity separately, so multiplying accounts multiplies capital at risk and ties it up; a yarrow or comet account name offers no exemption. This raises the cost of flooding without pretending that a bond proves a person is unique.
